title: AEGIS Local-First Core
objective: Build a local-first, zero-recurring-AI-cost home-network AI control plane on the UGREEN NAS that can continue projects across models, devices, text, and voice without losing project state.
hard_constraints: No recurring paid AI/API-token dependency in the default production path.
Cloud model fallback disabled by default and only enabled explicitly.
No public-Internet exposure of AEGIS management services by default.
No arbitrary privileged shell from AI tools.
Every autonomous improvement requires provenance, rollback, and last-known-good safety.
UGREEN NAS is the persistent 24/7 brain; workers are optional.
current_program_gate: physical UGREEN validation of local Codex OSS + Ollama + MCP project continuity
default_next_action: Run the pinned physical UGREEN gate, verify local coder and project-context MCP, then run a real Guardian/Real-Cycle before advancing.

continuity_rules: Continue the active project and pending action before introducing unrelated work.
Preserve established AEGIS names, gate terminology, and technical vocabulary.
Do not reset persona or re-introduce the project on a channel switch.
Voice responses may be shorter but must preserve decisions, constraints, and pending action.
If context is missing or unverifiable, state the context gap instead of inventing continuity.
Do not claim real hardware state without measured evidence.
